title: Same Tree
contract: Decide whether two level-order binary trees have identical shape and values.
reasoning: Serialize values and explicit null markers so shape differences remain visible.
Two subtrees are equal when both are null, or their roots and corresponding children are equal.
The recursive comparison can stop at the first mismatch and avoid full serialized copies. Value traversal without null markers cannot distinguish all shapes.
complexity: O(n+m) serialization output with builder, O(n+m)
O(min(n,m)) visited nodes before termination, O(h) stack
